paper_metadata.title: Acute and Chronic Changes in Diffusivity Measures after Sports Concussion

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study provides a clear description of the source population (university football players) and inclusion/exclusion criteria. However, the sample size is very small (n=18 concussed, n=10 controls), and it is a convenience sample from specific teams, which may not represent the broader population of concussed athletes. Participation rates of eligible vs. non-participants are not reported.

items.reasoning: The strategy, software, and thresholding are clearly explained.
